click.description: Crisp UI click: button press, toggle, selection. Sync the onset to the on-screen action.

click-soft.description: Quiet short click: low-key UI tap, soft selection, hover. Much quieter than click.

key-press.description: Single mechanical key press: one keystroke, one typed character.

typing.description: Typing run (~1.4 s of keys): text being typed. Start as the typing starts.

pop.description: Soft rounded pop: chip, tag, badge or row appearing. Sync the onset to the pop-in.

land.description: Round low thump of an element landing (card, word, logo). Onset ~30 ms after the landing frame.

shutter.description: Dry camera shutter: snap zoom, whip cut, freeze frame. Sync the onset to the snap.

chime.description: Three-note glockenspiel flourish: success, confirmation, a gentle positive beat.

notification.description: Short clean notification ding: alert, message in, toast or badge appearing.

ping.description: Single bright glockenspiel note: punchy accent on a key reveal or data point.

error.description: Two-note boop: failure state, a "wrong" beat, something denied.

impact-bass-1.description: Deep gated sub impact with a 1.3 s tail: logo or hero slam, headline landing. Onset on the hit frame.

impact-bass-2.description: Short swell into a deep hit: anticipation then the slam. Align peak to the reveal.

swish.description: Thin fast swish that stops dead: a card or line of text sliding in, a flick. Align peak 40 ms after the move lands.

snap.description: Bright dry snap tick: a lock-in, a latch, a crisp accent on a cut.

whoosh-short.description: Tight fast whoosh: quick swipe or slide, a fast element move. Align peak 40 ms after the move lands.

whoosh.description: Low whoosh that lands with a thump: fast reveal, hard transition. Align peak to the cut.

whoosh-cinematic.description: Big deep air whoosh (2 s): sweeping scene transition, a flood of colour. Align peak to the cut.

riser.description: Tension riser (2.8 s) that stops on its loudest moment: build into a cut or reveal. Align peak to the cut.

swell.description: Dark reverse swell that blooms just after a cut. Align peak 40 ms after the cut. At most one per reel.

sparkle.description: Granular sparkle: magical reveal, a shine on a hero element. Sync the onset to the highlight.

glitch-1.description: Punchy glitch burst that hits first: hard-cut accent or sudden reveal. Onset on the hit.

glitch-2.description: Crunchy stutter that ends on the cut: chaotic transition into the next shot. Align peak to the cut.

glitch-3.description: Low-key short glitch texture: subtle digital shift under other audio.
